acceptance_checks.finite_observation: all numeric observation and simulator arrays are finite
acceptance_checks.legal_initial_predicates: every BDDL initial predicate remains true after 10 settle steps
acceptance_checks.no_severe_penetration_or_explosion: minimum contact distance >= -0.01 m, maximum absolute qvel <= 50, and maximum object settling displacement <= 0.20 m
acceptance_checks.not_initially_successful: the task success predicate is false before and after settling
acceptance_checks.reset_reproducible: two independent full resets plus raw-state restoration and 10 settle steps have identical physical-state hashes; render hashes are recorded but not required
acceptance_checks.scene_task_match: suite/task/BDDL hash matches the frozen manifest
acceptance_checks.simulator_loadable: the task environment resets, restores, settles, and serializes
acceptance_checks.zero_historical_overlap: raw and settled hashes do not match any official fixed state, typed used-state registry identity, or earlier generated/probe payload

capacity_probe.pass_rule: at least 51 unique, serializable, reproducible accepted states among the 64 frozen seeds for every representative probe task

distribution_audit_rule.expanded_support_margin: max(family absolute margin, 10% of official range)
distribution_audit_rule.task_family_mismatch: more than 2/10 formal states outside expanded support OR median standardized feature-mean shift greater than 1.0
distribution_audit_rule.terminal_mismatch: at least 4/40 mismatched tasks in any feature family

selection_rule: For each task, accept only frozen policy-independent validity checks; sort accepted candidates by raw_state_sha256 then candidate_index; first 10 are formal and all remaining accepted states are reserve. Reserve is never activated adaptively.
